about_the_game:
Catch the Light is a home practice app for vision and reading. Short, focused sessions help develop attention, perception, and confidence while reading. Designed for people living with visual field differences such as scotoma or hemianopia, and for anyone who wants to support visual attention and everyday comfort.

What you do in 3–15 minutes a day

  • Light Practices to support attention and perception

  • Visual Practices in short mini-games

  • Reading Practices with different mechanics

  • Vision Map — a way to explore which areas you see (not diagnostic)

  • Daily Notes to track your impressions and habit

Your Journey

Mark your daily practice and follow your journey — this helps maintain motivation and awareness.

Who it’s for

For adults who want a simple, supportive home routine for reading, focus, and confidence. Suitable for people with visual field differences such as scotoma or hemianopia, and for anyone who wants to strengthen visual habits.

Important

Catch the Light is not a medical app and is not intended for diagnosis, treatment, or prevention of disease. All practices and maps are for personal use and self-observation only.

Privacy

Catch the Light does not collect medical data.

We do not collect, share, or sell personal information.

See our Privacy Policy for details.
